description: "Dark theme with purple accents for React Email."

## Installation

<CodeTabs>

<TabsList>
  <TabsTrigger value="cli">Command</TabsTrigger>
  <TabsTrigger value="manual">Manual</TabsTrigger>
</TabsList>
<TabsContent value="cli">

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @emailcn/react-email/theme-twitch
```

</TabsContent>

<TabsContent value="manual">

<Steps>
  <Step>**Install the following dependencies:**</Step>

```bash
npm install react-email tailwindcss
```

  <Step>**Copy and paste the following code into your project.**</Step>
  <ComponentSource
    src="registry/themes/twitch.ts"
    base="react-email"
    title="components/email/theme-twitch.ts"
  />
  <ComponentSource
    src="registry/bases/react-email/themes/email-theme.ts"
    base="react-email"
    title="components/email/email-theme.ts"
  />
  <Step>**Update the import paths to match your project setup.**</Step>
</Steps>

</TabsContent>

</CodeTabs>

## Usage

```tsx
import { Tailwind } from "react-email";
import { createEmailTailwindConfig } from "@/components/email/email-theme";
import { twitchTheme } from "@/components/email/theme-twitch";

<Tailwind config={createEmailTailwindConfig(twitchTheme)}>
  {/* Your email content */}
</Tailwind>;
```
